page.overview:
Who is Chihare Amano?

During the time of Pain's Assault and the Fourth Shinobi World War, Chihare was little and only remembers that her parents took her somewhere for evacuation. As an adult, she read magazines and watched shows that chronicled these events, making her realise how difficult those times were. She had no idea that this could happen because she was always protected. Chihare stayed home while the Five Great Shinobi Countries fought and the shinobi defended their villages with their lives. The girl took apart light bulbs, read scientific books, and all this alone. She constantly lived, being covered by the back of someone else. She was sure that many children the same age felt the same way. At some point in time, Chihare became a member of the Cultural Institute, and also acquired an underground laboratory in the Konohagakure, using the old home of Furie Kanhen. Initially, her specialty was astrophysics. For about six months she observed celestial bodies and discovered a star with strange movements. Little by little it changed its orbit from north to south, and then from south to north, revolving around another star. She reported this to the Cultural Institute, but no one believed that such a celestial body existed.

Chihare is a rather impulsive women who jumped into the fray when Naruto Uzumaki infiltrated her lab, closing the chapter and attacking randomly for five minutes without even wanting to look at who she was trying to kill. However, realising that the Seventh Hokage is standing in front of her, she politely apologises and even bows. She doesn't particularly like people and tries to work alone so she can better concentrate on her experiments. Chihare strives to benefit society while being very focused on learning about the nature of chakra. She is also a very stubborn person, which Naruto admired as she continued to experiment over and over again, despite numerous failures. Chihare is simple and straightforward, easily asking Naruto uncomfortable questions without feeling any embarrassment. However, after several days of communicating with the Seventh Hokage, Chihare became more open, beginning to feel guilty that she herself was not as happy as he was. She also admits that Naruto is the best Hokage, completely different from the others, although she is a little disappointed in him due to his paperwork in the office instead of being a shinobi. Naruto himself notes that some of Chihare's statements, which seem insignificant, sound very childish and, despite her dislike of people, she wants her work to be appreciated.

Chihare is described as a young woman who wore an apron when she first met Naruto Uzumaki.
